-- Fix GA Governor R runoff notes
UPDATE governor_races 
SET notes = 'D Primary Winner: Keisha Lance Bottoms (56.2%). R Runoff: Burt Jones vs Rick Jackson (June 16, 2026). Runoff date: June 16, 2026.'
WHERE state_code = 'GA';

-- Check June 2 primary states: IA, MT, NJ, NM, SD Senate races
SELECT state_code, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status
FROM senate_races 
WHERE state_code IN ('IA','MT','NJ','NM','SD')
ORDER BY state_code;
